description: RALEIGH – Yesterday, a national news outlet released a story detailing how under Roy Cooper’s watch, North Carolinians paid the most of any state in the nation for healthcare. Under Cooper’s reign North Carolina faced a 183% increase in healthcare premium costs, which is a more than $480 per month increase. Despite campaigning on affordability, under Cooper’s watch, life was anything but affordable.

title: ICYMI- Despite Campaigning on Affordability, Roy Cooper Oversaw the Highest Healthcare Costs in the Nation – Michael Whatley for Senate
